items.title: Deere & Company Q3 Earnings Call Highlights
items.summary: Deere & Company (NYSE:DE) reported higher third-quarter revenue and raised its fiscal 2026 outlook, citing operating execution, improving inventory health and continued strength in its construction and small agriculture businesses despite soft conditions in portions of the global farm-equipment mark

items.title: Deere Is Today’s Top S&P 500 Stock. Here’s Why.
items.summary: The agricultural machinery maker posts fiscal third quarter earnings per share of $5.10 from agricultural equipment sales of about $7.4 billion.

items.title: DE Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Construction & Turf Strength

items.title: Deere (DE) Q3 Earnings: Taking a Look at Key Metrics Versus Estimates
items.summary: While the top- and bottom-line numbers for Deere (DE) give a sense of how the business performed in the quarter ended July 2026, it could be worth looking at how some of its key metrics compare to Wall Street estimates and year-ago values.

items.title: Tariff Refunds Boost Deere’s Bottom Line
items.summary: Deere shares are up more than 7% today after the machinery maker's quarterly profit topped expectations despite continued weakness in its large farm equipment business. The company got back $110 million in tariff refunds during the quarter that ended Aug.
